name: Financial Foundation
description: Jenga-style debt tower (Mortgage, College Fund, Car Loan, Credit Cards, Groceries) that wobbles and nearly falls until the player drags a glowing gold Life Insurance block into the empty foundation slot. Magnetic snap, golden impulse, tower aligns -> Foundation Secured! -> end card. Life-insurance vertical, US market. Stage 1 greybox (procedural soft-clay), portrait.

params.endHeadline: Make your family's financial foundation unbreakable.
